data.title: 红月卡莲 · 沿海弯道的机车飒爽
data.description: 夕阳下的沿海公路观景台，卡莲单脚支在重型机车旁，皮夹克迎着海风，晚霞映照红发，呈现无拘无束的成熟风范。
data.action: leaning on parked motorcycle, wind blowing red hair, confident grin
data.lighting: vibrant orange and magenta twilight washing across the ocean
data.promptProse: Parked at a scenic coastal lookout at golden hour, Kallen Kouzuki leans against her sleek motorcycle, letting the twilight ocean wind ruffle her vibrant red hair.
data.animaCaption: Kallen leaning against her motorcycle overlooking a sunset sea.
